name: How much does an accessible bathroom remodel cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does an accessible bathroom remodel cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an accessible bathroom remodel can vary significantly depending on factors like the bathroom's size, the extent of modifications, choice of materials, and specific accessibility features installed. Basic modifications might start from $10,000 to $15,000, while comprehensive remodels with high-end fixtures and extensive structural changes can range from $25,000 to $50,000 or more. We provide detailed estimates after an initial on-site consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs range from $10,000 for basic modifications to over $50,000 for comprehensive remodels, depending on scope and materials.
